accuracy.evidence: Checked KE = ½mv² against AQA GCSE Physics Energy and NGSS HS-PS3-1. Worked examples re-done by hand: 60 kg at 5 m/s → 750 J; 2 kg at 4 m/s → 16 J; KE 200 J, m 4 kg → v = 10 m/s; doubling speed → ×4 energy; tripling → ×9.

misconceptions.evidence: Targets documented slips: forgetting ½; not squaring v; KE = mv; claiming doubling speed only doubles KE; mixing grams with m/s. Lab myth step and challenge feedback name each slip.

lab_distinct.evidence: flagkeq is calculation/rearrangement of KE = ½mv² with a plug-in cart readout and √ rearrange. flagkemv is the mass–speed dependence demo with tables/crash test; flagenergy is stores on a ramp. Lab gate measured under 30% shingle overlap.

lab_teaches.evidence: Learner reveals the formula, computes 750 J, discovers the four-times rule from v², rearranges for speed with a square root, and orders units-first method.

predictions.evidence: Six predictions with tempting wrong options the lab disproves: KE = m×v; 300 J instead of 750 J; doubling only doubles; wrong rearrange; the double-speed myth; skipping units.

challenge_feedback.evidence: Wrong tags cover lin/add/half/nosq/miss/mix/unit/true with messages that name the specific slip (missed square, missed half, wrong rearrange).

readability.evidence: Short sentences; curriculum terms kinetic energy, joule, rearrange, square root. Kid and adult paragraphs stay within family readability targets.

no_filler.evidence: No filler phrases. Each kid paragraph states one rule with an example; adult names standard, vocabulary, four mistakes and lab actions.

mobile.evidence: young class, large lbtn controls, canvas chips and options sized for 390 px; buttons twin every tap/drag.

accessibility.evidence: Every canvas action has a button twin; aria-label updated via say(); axe WCAG 2.1 AA expected clean in both themes via walk.cjs.
